title: ritual circle — lit
description: a ritual circle drawn on a dark stone floor: two concentric rings of faint pink-violet light with small plain marks around them (no letters, no symbols), a soft glow rising from it; flat on the floor, seen from the same three-quarter view, filling about 80% of the cell width

title: ritual circle — sealed
description: the SAME circle, same size and position, now dead: the rings are cold grey scratches on the stone with a few cracks across them, no light

title: archive cabinet — whole
description: a tall dark-wood archive shelf of the chancellery packed with tied bundles of papers and scrolls, a plain iron lock plate, standing on the floor; about 1.3 times a character's height

title: archive cabinet — burned
description: the SAME shelf after a fire: charred black wood, collapsed shelves, ash and a few curled burnt pages, thin smoke, same size and position
